intent.raw: Do a refine in this, maybe we are selecting a brittle implementation, then try to refine the other next components.
intent.operator_sentence: $refine inspect the portal blocker for brittleness and refine downstream components
intent.objective: Select one coherent relation identity/reference model and produce a non-executed repair plan that propagates it through UOVA portals, Path, navigation, UI models, geometry, renderers, projections, Body War integration, and acceptance.

route_menu.context_hint: The blocker may be a local schema omission or evidence of an inconsistent reference model across multiple downstream objects.

items.label: Patch portal only
items.description: Add exact_predicate to portal constituents without revisiting downstream identity flow; cheapest but risks duplicated semantic drift.

items.label: Compare relation models
items.description: Tournament normalized, denormalized, and hybrid reference models, then propagate the selected law through every downstream contract.

items.label: Rewrite scene model
items.description: Replace the current KnowledgeScene boundary wholesale; highest migration risk and not justified before compatibility analysis.

technique_overlays.trigger: The ten-stage Refine loop must preserve owner artifacts, native receipts, exact handles, and stop conditions.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every non-first stage consumes a prior artifact, decision, ledger, handle, or receipt and emits an owner-held artifact plus native receipt or exact blocked reason.

technique_overlays.trigger: Portal, Path, navigation, geometry, UI, inspector, and static contracts use relation identity differently and hide their resolution assumptions.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The evidence pack and design emit a complete relation-flow and field-ownership map with concrete source paths.

technique_overlays.trigger: Normalized reference-first, denormalized self-contained, and hybrid relation-facet models are all plausible and have different failure modes.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: All candidates are scored against semantic fidelity, drift risk, serialization, coupling, stale revisions, testability, performance, accessibility, and migration; rejected alternatives retain reasons.

technique_overlays.trigger: Self-contained presentation records compete with a single canonical semantic owner and minimal duplication.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Semantic-owner, serialization, interaction, and implementation roles converge only on a model with explicit invariants; unresolved tensions remain residue.

technique_overlays.trigger: A relation model that works for portals may still fail Path, geometry, selection, static output, or parallel relations.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Distill Repair emits evidence for mixed-direction portals, parallel relations, Path selection, stale revisions, geometry lookup, predicate encoding, and standalone static serialization.

technique_overlays.trigger: Prior narrow-fixture success and full-bundle relation collapse are material negative evidence but not current authority.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Prior evidence is linked without promotion, duplicated claims are deduplicated, and rejected repairs remain attributable residue.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The concern crosses semantic normalization, interaction state, and renderer/projection contracts; independent read-only analyses can proceed without overlapping writes.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Three bounded reviewers reduce the risk that a portal-local fix is selected before Path, navigation, geometry, renderer, and static requirements are checked. Refine retains route, artifact, decision, and synthesis ownership.
context: SWU-UOVA-004 is blocked because task prose and the closed portal schema disagree about exact_predicate.
PathHop, NavigationFrame, SceneGeometry, and UI contracts also use reference-shaped records.
The earlier full-graph route failed when distinct source relations collapsed in presentation mapping.

roles.purpose: Map canonical relation ownership and compare normalized, denormalized, and hybrid models across schemas and completed semantic-core code.
roles.owns: read-only relation-model comparison receipt; no design decision authority

roles.purpose: Trace relation identity through Path, NavigationFrame, UI View Models, encoding, geometry, renderer, inspector/index, static output, and Body War integration.
roles.owns: read-only downstream impact receipt; no product or planning mutation authority

roles.purpose: Attack the selected model for semantic duplication, lookup ambiguity, stale revisions, inaccessible self-containment, performance coupling, migration breakage, and vacuous tests.
roles.owns: read-only adversarial review receipt; Interrogation owns the formal design review

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirm this Refine strategy, including three bounded read-only subagents and local-first research-if-gap?

steps.name: Context Builder relation-flow evidence baseline
stop_conditions: A relation-bearing owner or concrete source path cannot be resolved.
Prior memory or generated evidence is treated as design authority.

steps.name: Invoke Define relation identity and reference laws
stop_conditions: Canonical relation, reference, snapshot, facet, resolution, or revision terms remain ambiguous.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: One owner exists for every semantic field.
Self-contained exports have an explicit snapshot law.
All runtime lookups are revision-bound and fail closed.
Named gaps have an owner or block research/design.
stop_conditions: A critical relation ownership ambiguity remains unnamed after the critique.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: A named external-context gap exists but external research has not been separately confirmed.
External evidence attempts to override repository-owned design contracts.

steps.name: Distill relation-model tournament
convergence_criteria: The selected model has one canonical semantic owner.
Portal, Path, navigation, geometry, renderer, inspector/index, and static output can all recompose from it.
Stale revisions and missing references fail deterministically.
Migration preserves completed SWU-UOVA-001–003 evidence where valid.
stop_conditions: No candidate is non-dominated across fidelity, drift risk, serialization, coupling, performance, accessibility, testability, and migration cost.

steps.name: Invoke Redefine and Design downstream relation flow
stop_conditions: The design duplicates semantic truth without a digest/equality invariant.
A consumer performs unbound lookup or infers ontology semantics.
Completed semantic-core compatibility is unassessed.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
convergence_criteria: Every semantic field has one authority and every copy has a validation law.
Selection and restoration use the same stable identity.
Migration and negative controls are concrete.
stop_conditions: A critical design contradiction has no repair owner after one critique cycle.

steps.name: Distill Repair and cross-component toy game
stop_conditions: Parallel relations collapse.
A portal or Path record cannot resolve its exact predicate/evidence.
Stale revisions are accepted.
Static output requires a second semantic graph.
The selected model fails recomposition into later UOVA components.

steps.name: Invoke Plan repair package
stop_conditions: The repair plan mutates completed evidence rather than superseding affected contracts.
A SWU lacks exact inputs, outputs, validation, compatibility, or successor criteria.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
convergence_criteria: The selected model and field ownership are coherent.
Every affected downstream component has a disposition.
Toy evidence falsifies known brittle alternatives.
The next route preserves owner boundaries and claim ceiling.
stop_conditions: Final synthesis exceeds design/plan evidence.
Any required stage lacks a native receipt, artifact, or exact blocked reason.

gates.condition: The operator explicitly approves this dispatch, its three read-only subagents, and local-first research-if-gap policy before any runtime stage or spawn.
Context Builder, Invoke, Interrogation, Distill, and Refine native capability handles and expected receipt shapes are available before their stages run.
All spawned read-only subagents are joined and closed with required receipts before their dependent stages consume findings.
External research runs only if a named local evidence gap appears and the operator separately confirms the bounded pass.
All writes remain inside this new run folder; completed UOVA artifacts, product code, ontology, Body War, Arcanum, Git, deployment, and promotion remain untouched.
Exactly one candidate relation model passes the Pareto and recomposition criteria, with rejected alternatives retained.
Cross-component toy evidence passes parallel, portal, Path, stale-revision, geometry, encoding, and static-output controls.
The non-executed repair package covers the blocker and every affected downstream contract with compatibility and validation obligations.
Refinement evidence grants no product mutation, ontology promotion, publication, deployment, release, or production claim.
Every canonical stage has a native receipt or exact blocked reason and RESULT.md stays within the design/plan claim ceiling.

boundaries.contract: Only concrete artifact, handle, decision, ledger, and receipt references cross stage boundaries; owner artifacts are not copied or redefined.
Memory is non-authority evidence and cannot change design or ontology state without direct owner evidence.
Subagents return bounded receipts; Refine and stage owners retain all artifact and decision authority.
External research is absent by default, requires named-gap confirmation, remains cited evidence, and cannot override local owner contracts.
Writes are confined to the new refinement run directory; no product, prior-run, ontology, Arcanum, Git, or external mutation.

authority.execution: native stage capability; subagents are read-only evidence roles
authority.validation: dispatch-spec for route shape; owning stage for its artifact; interrogation/distill for critique and repair
authority.evidence: refine evidence index with owner-held stage and subagent receipts
authority.memory: repository memory owner; visibility only, no promotion

promotion_splits.target: UOVA design, product, ontology, or reusable knowledge
promotion_splits.rule: No automatic promotion; a later owner-routed Invoke/Task Session or ontology governance decision is required.

promotion_guardrails: No runtime stage or subagent before explicit strategy permission.
No external research before a named gap and separate confirmation.
No product code, completed UOVA artifact, ontology, Body War, dependency, lock, Git, deployment, publication, or release mutation.
No Refine artifact is implementation, browser, accessibility, promotion, or production evidence.
